derivation_rationale.source_spine: FEMA Hazus hurricane building-loss functions (Hazus 7.0 TM method; Hazus 6.1 FEMA extract values), verified identical to SimCenter's independent Hazus 5.1 copy.
derivation_rationale.adopted_form: exact published 5-mph tables, straight lines between published points
derivation_rationale.why_not_smooth_fits: 41 published points per record; nothing to fill and a fit could only move published values.
derivation_rationale.parameter_tier_mix: Ordinates T2; building types T2-T3; wind characteristics T4 assumptions from T2 frequencies; terrain required input; value per area open.

legacy_comparison.legacy_arrays_used: none (legacy Climada residential and Unanwa straight-line arrays rejected, D-TCRE-10)
